title: He’s Back. Harrison Smith Returns for 15th Season

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: He’s Back. Harrison Smith Returns for 15th Season
sources.description: Harrison Smith is returning to the Minnesota Vikings for his 15th season. After an entire offseason of speculation, Harrison Smith, 37, is returning for one more season with the Vikings on a one-year deal. Tom Pelissero is reporting a $8 million deal with incentives that could double that amount, while Alec Lewis and Ian Rapoport […]
